title: Subthalamic local field potentials during the balloon analogue risk task (Pearson et al., 2017): Parkinson's disease DBS surgery (derivative: decimated LFP)
description: Intraoperative subthalamic nucleus (STN) local field potential recordings from patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation implantation at Duke University Medical Center. Patients performed a self-paced balloon analogue risk task (BART) while LFPs were recorded from single microelectrodes or 32-channel microwire arrays. This derivative repackages the LFP, decimated to 200 Hz, into BIDS iEEG format with behavioural and artifact-censoring events (17 recordings from 14 patients, about 4.3 h).
methods_description: Recordings used a Plexon MAP system with FHC Guideline 4000. LFP was acquired at 1 kHz and stored decimated to 200 Hz. Single tungsten microelectrodes were used for STN mapping, and in 7 datasets a 32-channel Pt/Ir microwire array was advanced into the STN. Spikes were sorted offline with WaveClus. Patients performed a self-paced balloon analogue risk task during localisation.
